hero.subtitle: The overseas recruitment partner for companies hiring construction, factory, hospitality, and technical workers — sourced, screened, and deployed.

intro.title: A recruitment partner built on trust and results.
intro.body: We connect qualified workers with international employers and help companies recruit the right people for their business — handling everything from sourcing and screening to visa processing and deployment.

categories.title: Workers across every trade.

one.title: Register
one.body: Workers register and submit their CV; employers share their requirements.

two.title: Screen & test
two.body: We screen candidates, verify documents, and arrange skills or trade testing.

three.title: Interview
three.body: We coordinate interviews between employers and shortlisted candidates.

four.title: Deploy
four.body: Visa processing, orientation, and travel — we handle deployment end to end.
